title: Fix Private Link DNS, identity, and observability gaps
intent: Checks the answer requires correct private DNS zone linkage, secretless workload/managed identity, and diagnostic settings with HA/geo alerts.
prompt: Review this Azure Managed Redis networking, identity, and monitoring setup and correct it.

input_artifacts.name: platform-setup.txt
input_artifacts.content: networking: clients connect directly to the privatelink hostname; private DNS zone linked only to the hub VNet, not the spokes; identity: primary access key hardcoded in app settings; monitoring: no diagnostic settings, no metrics, no alerts

embedded_defects.defect: Uses the privatelink host directly with hub-only DNS linkage, breaking spoke resolution.
Hardcodes an access key instead of using workload/managed identity with a data-access policy.
No diagnostics, metrics, or HA/geo alerts.
